headline: Canada Economic Growth Stalls in August with September Decline Expected
summary: Canada's economic growth stalled in August, and September is expected to register a decline.
why: Gross domestic product data tracks national economic health and directly guides the central bank's monetary policy path.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Stalling GDP growth points toward economic deceleration, affecting domestic asset valuations and currency strength.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Economic stagnation reports drive expectations of monetary easing or slower growth, impacting domestic currency and equities.
